summary: All three occurrences are already represented: 28/66 under the first quotation, and 43/10,13 under sense 2. No additional example is necessary solely because a cell is thin.

Sense 1 has reciprocal object ḥḏoḏe. Sense 2 has an escorted person (overt u xawaǧa at 43/13) and endpoint larwal or hul lu tarʕo baroyo. The inherited two senses are supported and retain their labels and language.
Reciprocity at 28/66 is expressed by the object rather than Detransitive morphology. The -li at 43/13 marks the first-person escorter; it is not an object suffix.
The form and constructions support treating farewell and seeing off in the same entry; these tokens do not independently settle the head's historical root question.
The inherited sense-2 parenthesis asks whether this is the same root. The three supplied forms are compatible with one II paradigm; historical identity requires evidence beyond these tokens.
